name.ja: 計測: スタミナがいつ減るか

description.en: Records every change to the stamina (physical_integrity / max_physical_integrity) and the exhausted flag of the player and party members with the caller chain, whether it happened during a quest or a battle, and the values around a quest start, a quest clear (QuestEndManager.execute) and a quest retreat: quest difficulty and type, level, stamina, HP, body part injuries, and the HP lost and healed during the quest. Groundwork for a mod that scales the stamina spent on a quest clear by difficulty and damage taken. Read-only
description.ja: 主人公と同行者のスタミナ（physical_integrity / max_physical_integrity）と疲労の旗（exhausted）が変わるたびに、呼び出し元の連鎖と、依頼や戦闘の最中かを録る。依頼に出たとき・クリア（QuestEndManager.execute）・放棄の前後で、依頼の難易度と種類、レベル、スタミナ、HP、部位の怪我、依頼の間に減った HP と回復した HP を並べる。クリアで減るスタミナを難易度と被弾で変える MOD の下調べ。読み取りだけでゲームは変えない
